item.title: OPERA PLACES Andriana Chuchman takes us to New York City
item.description: Ukrainian-Canadian soprano Andriana Chuchman takes us to New York City. This past weekend she made her debut at Alice Tully Hall in recital with the Chamber Music Society of of the Lincoln Centre. While in NYC, Andriana chats with us about her favourite museums, restaurant recommendations and her advice for exploring the city. Read on to find out more.

item.title: Artist of the Week 22 Qs for Clarence Frazer
item.description: The Artist of the Week is Canadian-Korean baritone Clarence Frazer. He will be singing the role of Guglielmo in Mozart's Così fan tutte at Vancouver Opera from February 7th to 15th. This week, Clarence chats with us about the hobby that keeps him grounded, his favourite city and the singers he loves to golf with. Read on to find out more.

item.title: OPERA PLACES Korin Thomas-Smith takes us to Dallas, Texas
item.description: Canadian baritone Korin Thomas-Smith takes us to Dallas, Texas, where he is singing the role of The Businessman in The Little Prince at The Dallas Opera from February 6th to 4th. While in Dallas, Korin chats with us about Texas BBQ, tips for finding accommodation and surviving the ice storm. Read on to find out more.

item.title: Artist of the Week 19 Qs for Brett Polegato
item.description: The Artist of the Week is Italian-Canadian baritone Brett Polegato. He will be singing the role of Scarpia in Tosca at Pacific Opera Victoria from February 18th to 24th. This week, Brett chats with us about upcoming performances, why he doesn't read reviews and an unexpected on stage kiss. Read on to find out more.
